detail.title: META Pencil 200 Active Stylus - Magnetic, POM Tip, White
detail.overview: The Ant META Pencil 200 is an active stylus built for iPad, Android tablets and smartphones, giving students, designers and note-takers precise, pressure-free control for writing and drawing. Its fine 1.5mm POM tip glides smoothly across the screen with high sensitivity and no perceptible lag, while a magnetic design lets it attach securely to a compatible device for storage and easy carrying. Type-C fast charging tops it up quickly, and a full charge delivers 8-10 hours of continuous writing or drawing time, making it easy to get through a full day of classes or creative work without needing a mid-session recharge.
